## Phase 1: Consolidate Feature Extraction Layer

**Duration:** 1.5 weeks (60 hours)
**Priority:** CRITICAL - Eliminates 30% code duplication
**Dependencies:** None

### Problem Statement

Currently, feature extraction is duplicated 5+ times per request:
- Text extraction from messages (3 implementations)
- Token counting (2 implementations)
- Complexity signal calculation (4 implementations)
- Message-to-prompt conversion (3 implementations)

### Tasks

#### Task 1.1: Create Unified FeatureExtractor Service
**Duration:** 3 days
**Assignee:** Backend Engineer

**Subtasks:**
- [ ] Design FeatureExtractor interface with caching
- [ ] Implement message text extraction (single source of truth)
- [ ] Implement token counting with tiktoken
- [ ] Add complexity signal calculation
- [ ] Create prompt conversion utilities
- [ ] Add request-scoped caching (in-memory)

**Deliverable:** `router_core/features/feature_extractor.py`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- All features extracted once per request
- Cache hit rate > 95% for repeated extractions
- Latency < 10ms for full feature extraction

#### Task 1.2: Integrate FeatureExtractor into Routers
**Duration:** 4 days
**Assignee:** Backend Engineer

**Subtasks:**
- [ ] Inject FeatureExtractor into RouteLLM router
- [ ] Inject FeatureExtractor into MIRT router
- [ ] Inject FeatureExtractor into Ensemble router
- [ ] Remove duplicate extraction code from each router
- [ ] Update unit tests to use FeatureExtractor
- [ ] Verify no regression in routing decisions

**Deliverable:** Updated router implementations

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Zero duplication in feature extraction code
- All routers use shared FeatureExtractor
- Performance tests pass (no latency increase)

#### Task 1.3: Performance Testing & Optimization
**Duration:** 1 day
**Assignee:** QA Engineer

**Subtasks:**
- [ ] Benchmark before vs after consolidation
- [ ] Measure cache hit rates
- [ ] Profile memory usage
- [ ] Load test with 1000 req/s

**Deliverable:** Performance report

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Latency reduction: 20-30% (less duplicate work)
- Memory usage stable or reduced
- Cache hit rate > 95%
